correctness.rationale: Exchangeability gives exact finite partwise states, and two i.i.d. uniform with-replacement offers give the rational Bellman recurrence. A finite uniform positive chance of a forced 1- or 2-edge path to each missing vertex makes all policies proper. Complete rational policy evaluation and Bellman-improvement checks enumerate 58 graph types with 7,391 states through order eight and all 29 order-nine types with 11,956 states. Unique strict exception graph K_(1,2,6); exactly three reduced failing decision states. A separate labeled-subset numerical Bellman computation agrees at the exact witness values to <1e-9. This is a finite exact proof; no infinite-order extension is claimed.

value.rationale: The precise first failure of greedy fresh-vertex preference in the highly symmetric complete multipartite class is a natural structural boundary for optimal controlled cover walks, not an arbitrary statistic. The strict optimal-versus-myopic policy reversal is exact and small yet subtle, and the complete census identifies a unique nine-vertex graph type. It is motivated by the practical and mathematical design of cover-time policies, while not claiming any broad complexity result or infinite-order theorem.
